svg.title: Four cars, ten past two in the morning
svg.desc: Four cars of a long-distance train drawn in section at two in the morning: a sleeping car with eleven berths and one light on, a dark dining car with one person doing paperwork, a lit kitchen with the cook awake, and a small service cubicle at the end.

g.text: Four cars, ten past two in the morning
Fourteen things to find. One berth has a bag in it and nobody in it.
the lower berths - one light on
the dining car - closed at nine
the kitchen - lit, at two in the morning
one berth with a bag and nobody in it
the luggage nobody claimed at Winnipeg
Dev - nine days in, doing paperwork
the only cup still warm on the train
the second cook - the third sitting is where you learn things
